title: feat(console): an admin can open a read-only package's app in Studio to look at it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只读软件包（代码包或已安装包，例如 HotCRM）的应用，管理员现在在顶栏能看到一个眼睛按钮「Open app in Studio」，在应用切换器里能看到「在 Studio 中查看 {app}」，打开的是 Studio 的只读浏览；可写包仍是铅笔「Edit」。
- 为什么改：#27356 第 12 行，按你的裁决 B（评论 6520616687）：「ai写完代码，人类需要进去确认啊」。objectui#12615 的理由只排除铅笔，不排除入口。
- 风险与回滚：只多画一个入口，不放开任何写权限；同一批管理员、同一道门；内核包、清单里没有的包、清单未读到时仍什么都不画。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`hooks/useStudioDesignGate.ts` 的 `useStudioEntryGate`（同一次 `writable` 读出 edit / view 两种姿态），`AppHeader.tsx` 顶栏按钮，`AppSwitcher.tsx` 的 Studio 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605.test.tsx`，应见 2 files passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Part of #27356 (row 12, hotcrm#2320 Studio S1: a read-only package's app opens in Studio to look at it; maintainer-ruled B, comment 6520616687)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The gate answers a posture.** `useStudioEntryGate(path)` (new, `hooks/useStudioDesignGate.ts`) reads the same two halves as before (a workspace admin holding `manage_metadata`; the package as Studio's package list carries it) and answers `{ path, posture }`: `edit` for a package the list carries `writable`, `view` for one it carries read-only, `null` otherwise. The posture comes from the server's `writable` verdict read once, in `packageStudioPosture`; no second derivation. `useStudioDesignGate` is now the `edit` half of that answer, so the sidebar ⋯ menu's Design entry and a page's Edit in studio pencil are unchanged.
- **App bar.** `edit` keeps the pencil, 「Edit app」. `view` draws an eye in the same slot, 「Open app in Studio」 (`data-testid="app-view-in-studio-button"`), to the same Studio path, which Studio opens in its read-only posture.
- **App switcher.** A new `studioPosture` prop (default `edit`): `view` turns the last row into 「Open APP in Studio」 with an eye (`app-switcher-view-in-studio`); `edit` keeps 「Edit APP in Studio」 with the pencil.
- **Kernel packages still draw nothing.** A manifest-scoped kernel package is already left out of the list. A kernel package the registry half serves flat (its `scope` top level) stays in the list read-only, because the list's visibility filter reads the manifest's `scope` only; `parsePackages` now marks such a row `kernel: true` (visibility unchanged), and the gate answers `null` for it. Without this the Setup app would have got the eye.
- **i18n.** Two keys added in all ten locales: `topbar.openAppInStudio` (en 「Open app in Studio」, zh 「在 Studio 中查看应用」) and `layout.appSwitcher.openAppInStudio` (en 「Open {{app}} in Studio」, zh 「在 Studio 中查看 {{app}}」). No key renamed, no en value changed.
- The surface grew, as the ruling grants, by `layout/**` and `hooks/**`; none of the files open PRs hold (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `ConsoleLayout.tsx` and the rest of the seat's list) is touched. `views/studio-design/packages-io.ts` is in the order's Studio surface.

## Tests

- `AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx` (real `AppHeader`, router and `MePermissionsProvider`, packages served at `fetch`): its reading now carries the eye and the switcher's posture too. The read-only package (HotCRM, `writable: false`) case changes from "nothing" to "no pencil, the eye to `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/interfaces?surface=dashboard:pipeline`, the switcher row to the same target in `view`, named 「Open app in Studio」". The writable CONTROL reads the pencil with posture `edit` and no eye. Setup, the unlisted package, the flat-served system package, the in-flight read and the failed read each read no pencil, no eye and no switcher row.
- `AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605.test.tsx` gains two cases: `view` draws 「Open HotCRM in Studio」 with the eye glyph and no Edit row; `edit` keeps 「Edit HotCRM in Studio」 with the pencil (the file's first case already reads the row with no posture passed).

<details><summary>Readings (head 6f086f63, branch rebuilt from origin/main bc496bf7 after #27978 merged; install and app-shell closure rebuilt)</summary>

- The two pinned files: 2 passed.
- Every ui test file naming `useStudioDesignGate`, `AppHeader`, `AppSwitcher`, `SidebarItemMenu`, `parsePackages`, `fetchPackages` or `packages-io`, plus the whole `packages/i18n/`: 326 files, 3011 passed / 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Ablation 1, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `return pkg.writable ? 'edit' : 'view';` to `... : null` (the read-only package gets nothing, as before): 1 failed / 8 passed (the HotCRM case red); restored blob = HEAD blob `df9f158d1490`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2: `if (!pkg || pkg.kernel) return null;` to `if (!pkg) return null;` (the flat-served kernel row gets the eye): 1 failed / 8 passed (the flat system package case red); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source, so neither ablation needed a rebuild.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift`: 0 en values changed (2 keys added, all ten packs).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 14 is answered C (will not do), per the ruling.** The Data pillar's grid columns, its Form canvas and the one field inspector are the object's field designer; objectui#5813 ("fields ARE the grid's columns, so a separate fields tab would ADD a surface") and the seven-tab ruling of objectui#12450 (decision B of objectui#12446) stand. No change for row 14.
- Row 19 (Delete flow in Studio, ruled A1) follows as its own PR after this one.
- The eye opens Studio where the pencil would have (`appStudioRoutePath`'s deep link). Studio's own read-only posture (row 13, #27927) is what the viewer then sees; this PR promises a look, not an edit, and the server's write gate is unchanged.
- The `kernel` mark reads a flat row's top-level `scope`, the position the registry half serves; it changes no visibility. Whether a real server serves Setup flat was not measured here; the existing pin says it does.
